method: truth per symbol of the parent version: changed iff `git diff -w --ignore-blank-lines -U0` lines inside the symbol (parent range for removed, child range for added) differ after dropping comment-only lines, trailing comments and all whitespace; gone iff the tail is absent from the child file; wsComment iff a plain diff touched it but truth is unchanged. Ranges from the TS parser (getStart..end). Synthetic scenarios are labelled by construction.
